procedure.startup:
printf '#!/bin/bash
exec bash /mgtools/exp_search/bin/exp_search "$@"
' > /usr/local/bin/exp_search && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/exp_search && printf '#!/bin/bash
exec bash /mgtools/exp_read/bin/exp_read "$@"
' > /usr/local/bin/exp_read && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/exp_read
dry_run_commands: exp_search "TypeError when calling a function with wrong arguments" > /tmp/mg_s.txt; cat /tmp/mg_s.txt; ID=$(grep -o 'ID: [^ ]*' /tmp/mg_s.txt | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2); exp_read "$ID"
procedure._comment: THIRD-PARTY SKILL SYSTEM, ORIGINAL ARM, version 2 (note M-4): as memgovern-orig.json, but MemGovern's retrieval step (and its tools' docstrings) is inserted as step 3 of mini-swe-agent's recommended workflow, where MemGovern's own agent config puts it (config/dsv31t_agenticMemSearch_1220_13w.yaml: after reproducing the error, before editing; its step 4 says '(Apply insights from step 3 if available)'). Version 1 appended the step after the issue text, inside <pr_description>, followed by mini-swe-agent's own 5-step workflow without it; the real model then called exp_search 0 times on 10 of 10 tasks (A102).
